scope: Recorded main-paper experiments and their actual historical execution profiles

minimal.identity_rule: same plan ID; sparse IDs define fused output identities
minimal.residual_rule: sparse-minus-dense coordinate residual from shared frames whose IoU is at least residual_tau; two-sided linear interpolation and nearest extension outside the reference span
minimal.ownership: corrected dense owns its observation frames, including rejected sparse overlaps; sparse fills frames without dense observations
minimal.gap_rule: linear interpolation of interior missing frames only when the final endpoint boxes meet gap_tau; no endpoint extrapolation

legacy_v13.description: Historical multi-gate fusion; not an alias for minimal and not a one-threshold ablation
legacy_v13.ownership: sparse-first; trusted sampled-SAM overlay, with sparse-only fallback when target reliability gates fail

fallback.rule: unchanged dense export for sparse failures

planning_anchor_budget.exception_policy: Recorded recovery preserved every selected target identity by retaining or adding registered-grid coverage anchors. It explicitly treated the three-anchor limit as soft; no GT was used.
planning_anchor_budget.fresh_generation_note: A fresh strict three-anchor planner run does not automatically reproduce these historical recovery exceptions. Exact replay requires the corresponding archived final plans and source maps; neither truncate them to three nor claim all test plans used at most three anchors.

comparators.sparse_linear: same sparse amodal predictions as fusion; unconditional interior linear box interpolation, no SAM or endpoint extrapolation
comparators.direct_amodal: independent answer-instance selection in first JPEG chunk, target registry carried into later chunks; no saved SD-Track plan, prior answer, SAM or GT input
comparators.fusion: same plan, dense observations and sparse amodal predictions, minimal profile

cost_convention.basis: historical recorded-token estimates, not billing invoices
cost_convention.comparison: all rows normalized to the historical Standard rate schedule
cost_convention.direct_cost_note: Direct includes its own answer selection in its recorded Direct calls; no external shared-plan cost is appended. Received paid retry responses are counted.

portability_note: Recorded source filenames and digests identify historical evidence. Public files may contain portability edits and have separate release checksums. No private source path is required.
